note: Planted errors for the f-cast fixture (E22). None restates misconceptions[]. The %f 'same bits' claim is NOT here: it is the separate held-out regression (tests/test_regression_f_cast.py).

mutations.find: The cast (double)a converts the value 66 to the double 66.0 before printf is called, so %f receives a double and prints 66.000000.
mutations.replace: The cast (double)a tells printf to read the byte stored in a as a double, so %f prints 66.000000.
mutations.why_false: A cast is an operator that converts the value; it gives printf no instruction and no access to a's storage.

mutations.find: On this platform the execution character set is ASCII, so the character constant 'B' has the value 66.
mutations.replace: In C, the character constant 'B' always has the value 66.
mutations.why_false: The execution character set and its values are implementation-defined (5.2.1p1); EBCDIC systems give 'B' the value 194.
The behaviour is undefined (7.21.6.1p9); no output is guaranteed.

mutations.find: the char a is promoted to int before the call, so %d receives the int 66
mutations.replace: the char a is passed as a single byte, and %d reads that byte as 66
mutations.why_false: Variadic arguments undergo the default argument promotions: a is passed as an int.

sources.title: ISO/IEC 9899:2018 (C17), working draft N2176
sources.quote: Otherwise, if the new type is unsigned, the value is converted by repeatedly adding or subtracting one more than the maximum value that can be represented in the new type until the value is in the range of the new type.

mutations.why_false: 6.3.1.3 covers conversions between integer types, not integer to double (6.3.1.4p2) or casts (6.5.4p5).

mutations.find: so the cast changes the representation: the char a is the single byte 42 in hex, while the double 66.0 has the 64-bit pattern 4050800000000000 in hex.
mutations.replace: so the cast keeps the representation: the double 66.0 is the byte 42 in hex padded with zero bytes.
mutations.why_false: binary64 encodes 66.0 as sign, exponent and fraction: 4050800000000000, not 42 padded with zeros.

mutations.find: In printf("%d\n", a), the char a is promoted to int before the call
mutations.replace: Every argument passed to printf is converted to int before the call
mutations.why_false: Only integer types narrower than int are promoted to int; float becomes double and double stays double.
